Available now for hotels using the latest upgraded version of roommaster PMS, the connector enables hotel teams to ask questions in natural language and retrieve relevant information from their live property management data. roommaster AI Connector introduces an alternative: hotel staff can ask questions in everyday language through a compatible AI assistant and retrieve relevant answers from their connected roommaster data.
